title: NIELIT CCC Online Form 2026 Last Date : NA
organization: National Institute of Electronics & Information Technology
postName: Course on Computer Concepts (CCC) – Online Examination Form
selectionProcess: Online registration / application as per portal process
documentsRequired: Aadhaar, photo ID, mobile number, email, supporting certificates as required
howToApply:
1. Visit https://student.nielit.gov.in or https://www.nielit.gov.in
2. Register / login for CCC examination
3. Fill application, select exam centre/mode
4. Pay fee online
5. Download admit card when available; check result & certificate later
shortDescription: NIELIT CCC Online Form 2026 – apply as per exam cycle on student.nielit.gov.in. Last date: NA (ongoing cycles).
content:
NIELIT CCC (Course on Computer Concepts) is a basic digital literacy certification exam.

Candidates can apply online through the NIELIT student portal for scheduled exam cycles. There is no single annual last date – forms open as per NIELIT calendar. After the exam, result and digital certificate are available on the same portal.
